content: Those annotation vectors of the source sentences are combined in the attention layers in a way that the resulted vector encodes the source context relevant to the considering target word the decoder should produce. Intuitively, a relevance between the previous target word INLINEFORM0 and the annotation vectors INLINEFORM1 corresponding to the source words INLINEFORM2 can be used to form some attention scenario: DISPLAYFORM0
